fees.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/county/marion/Park/Roberts-Creek-Park ('50 Amp Electric/Water site $25.00'; '50 Amp Electric/Water/Sewer site $30.00'), read 2026-11-02; $4 processing fee as read on the same county's East campsite pages

note: Marion County Conservation park on the county's 300-acre Roberts Creek Lake, next to Lake Red Rock; county-run, not Army Corps. West campground runs along a wooded ridge road with a campground host. --Claude
summary: County map and page confirm 67 sites and hookups; fees low 30->25 (sites 45-46); sites 26-36 non-reservable added; not waterfront holds; pin is at the entrance.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront holds. Sites are in unbroken woods. The lake's south side lies beyond the highway; an arm lies about 300 m northeast through trees (imagery).

FEE BASE: the $25 rests on sites 45-46, the only water/electric ones. Their pad length isn't posted and they're drawn short, dark and at an angle on the map, so a 23-ft fit is unconfirmed. If they don't fit, low stays 30. No individual West campsite page could be read (my URL guess errored and the park page's list is loaded by script), so pad lengths, season and stay rules weren't read here: East's pages state 6-month window, weekend/holiday minimums and last-Sunday-October to second-Friday-April closure, probably county-wide. Left stored.

FACILITIES: the park page's West text lists showers but no dump station ('modern shower building, two additional flush restrooms'); only East's lists one. Stored dump true left alone, but it may mean East's station.

PIN: stored 41.42253,-93.05803 is on the access spur by the highway near registration (the county's own West map point is the same place). Site centre is about 41.4249,-93.0608 (imagery; about 350 m). Campground stretches about 700 m along the road.
